title: ML Pipeline for weather forecasting
subtitle: Automated weather forecasting pipeline for PM2.5 levels in Rotterdam
challenge: Automating the creation and updating of a ML prerdictor model based on sensor data for predicting PM2.5 levels in Rotterdam.
approach: Creating a pipeline that creates features from sensor data and trains a regression model using PyTorch, which is updated every day to predict the next weeks's PM2.5 levels.
impact: Create a webpage that displays the predicted PM2.5 levels in Rotterdam, with a live update every day.
